name: one best per player
a tie goes to the earlier submission, then the lower id; a player tied with themself shows the earlier run
one condition takes only its runs
all takes each player's best across the three conditions
a qualifying heat feeds the lap board
a qualifying heat is not on a race board
a final of 5 minutes is not on the 3-minute board
a final of 5 minutes is on the 5-minute board, and both on the lap board
(A*) rows are ranked like any other
eleven players: ten shown, the eleventh not, and not mine
eleven players: the tenth is mine at index 9
a race board: more laps first, then the lower time
a run with no counted lap is on no lap board
a run with no counted lap is on no race board
another direction, class or track is another board
a viewer with no run there has no mine
a guest has no mine
a finish that is not the player's best keeps their place, best false
a finish is ranked on the board of its own weather
a qualifying heat's finish has a lap rank and no race rank
